text:
maya: Heads-up: PR #4321 changes the /generate request schema. The 'verbosity' field is now an enum (nullable) instead of a numeric level. The top example and the Rust SDK snippet still show "verbosity: 1". Need coord to update API ref, examples, and SDK snippets. cc @sam

sam: Where's the Rust snippet located? Is Python/Go impacted too?

ivan: Runtime will coerce ints to enum strings for now, so it's not an immediate break, but coercion will be removed in the next minor. Docs should show canonical enum strings (Low|Medium|High), a nullable example, and a migration note.

maya: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321 1 - generate.md top example + Rust snippet at bottom.

sam: I'll update the Rust snippet to use the enum and add a nullable example. Draft to add:

```rust
let req = GenerateRequest {
  model: "rw-1",
  prompt: "Summarize the following...",
  verbosity: Some(Verbosity::High), // enum: Low|Medium|High
  ..Default::default()
};
let resp = client.generate(req).await?;
```

// Also add note: older clients accepted numeric levels but prefer enum strings going forward.

ivan: Add a sample with verbosity omitted (null) and a note describing default behavior (Medium). Also include an example curl snippet using the string value so external users see canonical form.

maya: docs-bot added checklist item: "update API examples + changelog/migration note". Can we include a one-paragraph migration blurb in CHANGELOG.md explaining coercion removal and recommended mapping from ints to enum strings?

deploy-bot: FYI Dedicated runtime also supports coercion currently but its scheduled to be removed in the next minor release. Recommend we call out a migration window (2 weeks) and provide a quick script to map ints to strings.

sam: I'll update the PR: Rust enum example, curl and python examples using strings, a nullable example, and a one-paragraph migration note in CHANGELOG.md with suggested mapping (0->Low, 1->Medium, 2->High). Will request reviews from @maya and @ivan when ready.

maya: Thanks. Please ping when CI passes. Ill merge once tests/docs build and reviewers approve.

ivan: Quick note for release docs: add a short compatibility note in the API reference entry for /generate and add a deprecation banner in the runtime changelog.

docs-bot: Reminder set: add migration example codeblock and update SDK snippet for Rust + Go + Python.

sam: Got it. Will include examples for all three SDKs and a short sed/perl one-liner for batch migrations.

maya: :thumbsup: Appreciate the fast turnaround.
